verdict.rationale: Apple's own materials make a gaming claim for the M4 family GPU: an improved hardware-accelerated ray-tracing engine that makes games like Control look more compelling. They cite no frame rates, cache, or boost behavior, and no independent game benchmarks are in the pack. The community item only asks whether it competes with RTX gaming PCs, which is a question, not corroboration or contradiction. missing for 10: measured frame rates in real games, independent game benchmarks, vendor detail on cache/boost behavior, GPU-class comparisons

support.subject: As a gamer, this chip drives high frame rates in real games — vendor gaming claims (cache, boost behavior, integrated GPU class) corroborated by independent game benchmarks

citations.quote: with the improved hardware-accelerated ray-tracing engine in the M4 family GPU, games like Control look more compelling
